newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis Air 1996 results up 76 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tunis Air 1996 results up 76 pct.

text.p: Tunisian flag carrier Tunis Air post-tax net profits were 26.57 million dinars ($24.26 million) in 1996, up 76 percent from 15.1 million dinars in 1995, final results showed on Wednesday.
Turnover was 515.57 million dinars compared to 483.5 million dinars.
Net operating profit was 9.736 million dinars, down from 30.4 million dinars. The company has allocated a 32.609 million dinars to reserves and 70.864 million dinars to the write off account.
The results were presented to the company's annual meeting held on Wednesday. ($=1.0952 dinar)
